claims.text: A classical Risset rhythm uses octave-related tempo layers and local acceleration or deceleration with global closure under layer relabeling.
AGL's canonical MVP starting profile uses a 2:1 ratio, 20-second cycle, 120 BPM nominal center, raised-cosine half-width B=2, and linear-partition normalization.
claims.qualification: These are construction-informed product defaults, not universal psychoacoustic optima.

claims.text: A 3:2 metric overlay may alter or strengthen the perceived endless-tempo effect.
claims.qualification: Polyrhythmic ambiguity is supported, but Risset-specific enhancement is unvalidated.

claims.text: The composite has a single physical BPM that literally increases forever.
Christopher Nolan publicly described the Troy sequence in The Odyssey as using a Risset rhythm and continuous acceleration.
claims.qualification: This does not disclose the exact soundtrack/session implementation.

claims.text: AGL's preset exactly reconstructs Ludwig Göransson's production session or the soundtrack track Troy.
Web Audio scheduling time, not JavaScript timer wake time, is the musical timing authority for scheduled browser audio.
The initial scheduler benchmark candidate is a 25 ms wake interval, 100 ms horizon, and 250 ms maximum adaptive horizon.
claims.qualification: These values require target browser/hardware calibration.

claims.text: Different browser engines will render byte-identical PCM for the same Web Audio graph.
Sonification maps information or data relationships into acoustic relationships that support interpretation or communication.
No single auditory dimension is universally best across tasks, listeners, contexts, and simultaneous mappings.
High pitch universally and intuitively means more for every user and source concept.
A browser gain value, limiter, or dBFS target guarantees hearing-safe sound pressure at the listener's ears.
A regular de Bruijn pentagrid can generate a P3 Penrose rhomb tiling with exact integer/algebraic topology.
The current AGL runtime produces validated exact Penrose patches.
claims.qualification: Not permitted until the generator, recovered/regenerated golden/oracle corpus, matching validation, and property suite pass.

claims.text: A finite rendered patch by itself proves global aperiodicity or self-similarity.
Explore, Compose, and Inspect should be coordinated workspaces over one project rather than separate semantic modes.
The native MVP proof should use a ports-and-adapters client with one active audible project and shared cross-platform fixtures.
claims.qualification: This is an architecture choice, not an iPadOS platform requirement.

claims.text: AGL shares contracts and conformance before sharing implementation; Rust or Swift/Wasm require measured evidence before adoption.
